description: List every venue BlackForge covers (9 spot exchanges) and every column it measures (one wide row per (exchange, symbol) per minute, served at 1m, 5m, 1h and 1d: order-book depth and shape, resting-liquidity lifetimes, trade-explained vs book-implied volume, spreads, and market-wide context). `metricCount` is the exact number of columns available now. Each metric carries a precise measurement definition, unit, family, and the minimum plan that includes it, the `intervals` it is served at, and, where the 5m/1h/1d value is a rollup of minute values rather than a re-measurement, a one-sentence `rollupNote`. `availableFrom["1m"]` is when the one-minute rows start (null before). `availableFrom.bookOnBoundary` maps each venue to the first window end whose order book was read as it stood at that instant (such rows have `bookObservedAt` equal to `ts`, so venues line up), null before; the order book columns carry a one-sentence `bookTimingNote` on it. The `qualityFlags` metric also carries the `bits` table that decodes the per-row quality mask. This route needs no API key. CALL THIS FIRST to learn the exact `exchange` and `metric` identifiers the other tools accept.
